findings.description: Month-end payment surge exceeded level-1 support staffing; the day-9 SEV-3 response missed its next-business-day target. Backlog: cross-train sub-city support for month-end cover.
Sandbox file-descriptor ceiling encountered during load rehearsal (DEF-08-01) is a hosting-provisioning item; documented in operations manual v1.1 hosting section for the production estate.
Competency decay observed around day 60 at one woreda desk; backlog: registrar refresher round before the Wave 2 rotation.

Open item O-1 (official Amharic fine-ladder figures) remains with the directive issuer; configurable PEN-* parameters carry PENDING_OFFICIAL_TEXT and the engine reads parameters, so the update is a data change. Residual risk accepted at closure.
Woreda desks requested SMS receipt notifications to parties after payment recording; recorded as an enhancement opportunity in the backlog.
Wave 2 (city-wide) cutover order pending with city operations; sequencing gates satisfied (Wave 1 live, O-7 closed, checklist green) and the wave procedure is in runbook v1.1.

lessons: Migration succeeded because the register was treated as the contract: Dir. Art. 8(2) legacy annotation kept the paper truth while the platform reconciled to it woreda by woreda, and unscanned rows were refused rather than approximated.
Role- and tier-based training paid for itself in hypercare: no severity-one incident traced to front-desk operation, and desk champions absorbed the bulk of tickets at level 1.

Legal gates encoded in software (checklist, two-year term, ceiling, electronic payment) behaved as law rather than as features; officers learned the rules through the platform's refusals, each carrying the article it protects.
Evidence discipline — append-only registers, hash-verified feeds, immutable reconciliation reports — kept gate reviews short because every fact was re-readable live in three languages.

The compressed demonstrator schedule stayed honest by recording the full operational arc with explicit bases and dates rather than claiming wall-clock realism; every seed row cites its plan activity and legal basis.
Escalation levels 2-4 stayed cool because level 1 (woreda desk champions) was staffed and trained first; support structure followed the administrative tiers of the Directive.
